notes.title: PATCH #1
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first update of the game. It is mainly about Languages.

[list]
[*]Added Simplified Chinese Language support
[*]Added Russian Language support
[*]Added Turkish Language support
[*]Close camera view is changed to make it look accurate.
[*]Fixed a bug that causes you get a different character than it is supposed to.
[/list]
